en_title: The Witcher 3 Fans Relieved to Find Low-Polygon Pigeons Have Survived the Remaster Process
cn_title: 《巫师3：狂猎-重制版》保留低模鸽子
subtitle: 鸽子还在
opus_summary: 《巫师3：狂猎-重制版》虽然加入大量画面改进，却保留了备受玩家喜爱的低多边形鸽子。游戏为飞行和落地鸽子使用不同模型，重制版已刷新原作Steam在线人数纪录。

paragraphs.en: The Witcher 3 Remastered brings tons of graphics improvements, but developer CD Projekt Red has left one incredibly important creature as it was: the pigeon.
paragraphs.cn: 《巫师3：狂猎-重制版》加入了大量画面改进，但开发商CDPR保留了一种极其重要的生物原样不动：鸽子。

paragraphs.en: Ahead of the remaster's public release, updated pigeon models were found in the game, but it only seems to apply to pigeons that are hanging out on the ground. Still, some people were upset with the assumed change, with one person posting the new ground-based model with the old flying one in a Reddit post captioned, "Gone, but never forgotten."
paragraphs.cn: 在重制版公开发售前，玩家曾在游戏中发现更新后的鸽子模型，但这似乎只适用于停在地面上的鸽子。尽管如此，还是有人因以为鸽子模型发生变化而感到失望。一名用户在Reddit上发布了新的地面鸽子模型和旧的飞行鸽子模型，并配文道：「虽已离去，却永远不会被遗忘。」

paragraphs.en: Luckily, it seems like the beloved low-poly pigeon has survived the remaster, as it was spotted by Kotaku Editor-in-Chief Ethan Gach on X / Twitter out in the wild. Apparently, The Witcher 3 uses different pigeon models for flying and grounded birds! If anything, the low-polygon pigeon looks even funnier in the remaster, as it shows the (lack of) detail even better with the updated lighting.
paragraphs.cn: 幸运的是，这只备受喜爱的低多边形鸽子似乎在重制版中幸存了下来。Kotaku主编Ethan Gach在X上偶然发现了它。显然，《巫师3》会为飞行中的鸽子和停在地面上的鸽子使用不同模型！在更新后的光照效果下，低多边形鸽子反而显得更加滑稽，也更能凸显它细节的（缺乏）。

paragraphs.en: Street pigeons have always been different from the ones flying. https://t.co/flLv1VgqF6 pic.twitter.com/6JFGuzZ7K2
paragraphs.cn: 街头鸽子一直和飞行中的鸽子有所不同。https://t.co/flLv1VgqF6 pic.twitter.com/6JFGuzZ7K2

paragraphs.en: So, even though The Witcher 3 Remastered came with a whole host of graphics improvements, it does seem like some old assets have kept their place in the game. Hopefully, CD Projekt Red also kept in some of the low-detail food in the game as well.
paragraphs.cn: 所以，尽管《巫师3：狂猎-重制版》带来了大量画面改进，但一些旧素材似乎仍保留在游戏中。希望CDPR也保留了游戏里那些低细节食物。

paragraphs.en: The Witcher 3 Remastered has only been out a few hours, but it's already breaking player records . It's broken the 11-year-old game's peak Steam concurrent player count, and the number looks set to rise further as we get closer to the weekend.
paragraphs.cn: 《巫师3：狂猎-重制版》发售才几个小时，就已经打破了玩家人数纪录。它已经超过这款11年前游戏在Steam上的最高同时在线人数，而且随着周末临近，这一数字看起来还会继续上升。

paragraphs.en: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Remastered is available as a free update on PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2. To ease you into Geralt’s life on the road, check out the things The Witcher 3 doesn’t tell you , plus IGN’s The Witcher 3 walkthrough and The Witcher 3 endings guide, which outlines all of the major quests and choices in the base game and expansions (now bundled in with the Remastered edition). When you’re ready for the tough choices, check out our The Witcher 3 sex and romance guide to see who Geralt can smooch and all the opportunities to do so. And to make Geralt as strong a monster hunter as possible, check out all the Witcher gear locations , Places of Power locations , and even Gwent card locations .
